class.name: SteamAudioStream
class.brief_description: You do not need to, and [b]should not[/b] assign this stream to your [SteamAudioPlayer], as the extension handles that for you.
class.description: Internal stream wrapper that retains the user-provided stream and creates [SteamAudioStreamPlayback] so the corresponding [SteamAudioPlayer] can process its audio. It is installed automatically when a player enters the scene tree.
